title: eval-harness: add prompt-set regression CI hook + quality gating for release branches
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Adds a CI hook that runs prompt-set regression checks and prevents merges to release branches when quality thresholds regress. No user-facing API changes.
description:
Context: Our eval-harness needs to prevent accidental prompt-set regressions from being merged into release branches. This PR introduces a lightweight CI hook that runs the canonical prompt regression suite (a subset of evaluation harness prompt sets) in the PR pipeline and enforces configurable quality thresholds. Motivation: reduce production regressions caused by prompt changes and model rollouts; provide early signal to engineers. Changes: 1) CI hook implementation (ci/hooks/prompt_regression_hook.py) that downloads the canonical prompt set, runs evals with a caching layer, computes failure-rate and delta metrics, and posts a GitHub check. 2) A gating config (ci/configs/eval_gating.yml) that defines thresholds per branch (main, release/*) and per-metric (exact-match, top-k-accuracy, semantic-similarity). 3) Test harness updates and unit tests for the hook and runner. 4) Docs describing how to add prompt sets and interpret gating results. Design notes: the hook runs a fast mode by default (sampled prompts + cached model outputs) and falls back to full-run when a change is near threshold; it emits structured metrics to the CI check summary to allow triage. Checklist:
- [x] Implement CI hook and gating config
- [x] Unit tests for runner and threshold logic
- [x] Integration test in ephemeral CI environment
- [x] Documentation (docs/eval-harness/quality-gating.md)
Testing notes: ran the hook against staging models and a canary PR; verified gating prevents merge when threshold exceeded and posts actionable failure message with links to failing prompts and suggested rollback commands. Backwards compatibility: config default mirrors current no-gating behaviour for hotfix branches. Rollout plan: enable gating in protected release/* branches initially as warning, then enforce after one week of monitoring.

merge_outcome: Merged by Miguel Santos via squash merge to main. Merge commit message: "eval-harness: add prompt regression CI hook + gating (ENG-1024, ENG-2048)". Post-merge: gate enabled in protected release/* branches as warning mode; team notified in #infra-evals.
notes_for_qa: To reproduce: create a PR that modifies a prompt set, include the label `no-eval-gate` to opt out, or run the hook locally: python ci/hooks/prompt_regression_hook.py --mode sampled --branch release/1.2.0. Failure output includes a JSON artefact at /tmp/prompt_gating/<pr_number>.json with per-prompt metrics.
